en: The postcard displays a historical black-and-white image of a monumental fountain featuring a dominant statue of a woman with draped clothing and raised arm, standing atop a multi-tiered cascade adorned with figures and beasts. Surrounding the fountain are ornate, multi-story buildings typical of late 19th to early 20th-century European architecture. There are people visible in period clothing, and water is cascading dramatically over multiple levels of the fountain.
